examples.arabic: أمي، الله يطول بعمرها، صارت عم تحضّر القهوة السخنة، وإخوتي الصغار مبسوطين عم بيلعبوا جوّا البيت.
examples.english: My mother, may God prolong her life, started preparing the hot coffee, and my younger siblings are happy playing inside the house.
examples.transliteration: ommi, Allah ytawwil bi-'omraha, sarat amm t'haddir al-qahwe as-sukhneh, w ikhweti az-zghar mabsoteen amm bayla'bu jawwa al-bet.
examples.storyTitle: Family Warmth in a Damascus Winter

examples.arabic: القهوة كانت سخنة والشاي كان حلو.
examples.english: The coffee was hot and the tea was sweet.
examples.transliteration: Al qahwa kanat sukhne wal shay kan hulu.

examples.arabic: سارة: هل شربتي قهوة ولا شاي اليوم؟
examples.english: Sarah: Did you drink coffee or tea today?
examples.transliteration: Sara: Hal shribti qahwa wala shay alyom?
examples.storyTitle: A Conversation Between Sarah and Sarah

examples.english: We drink coffee and eat bread.

examples.arabic: سامي عزم جاره يشرب قهوة ببيته
examples.english: Sami invited his neighbor to drink coffee in his house.
examples.transliteration: sami azam jaro yeshrab ahwe bbayto

examples.arabic: انصدم رامي، صاحب القهوة العصبي اللي عمرو خمسة وتلاتين سنة، لما فتح خزانته بشارع الحمرا واكتشف إنو عمال التوصيل ما جابوا كياس البن.
examples.english: Rami, the stressed thirty-five-year-old coffee shop owner, was shocked when he opened his cabinet on Hamra street and discovered that the delivery workers did not bring the bags of coffee beans.
examples.transliteration: Insadam Rami, saheb el ahwe el asabi elli amro khamse w tlatin sene, lamma fatah khazanto bi sharee el Hamra w iktashaf inno ommal el tawsil ma jabu kiyas el bon.
